messages.author: 6e907f43a3cfc8c8
messages.subject: SWAT+gwflow module
parts:
Dear Dr. Tam Nguyen,
I have been using the RSWAT tool for SWAT and SWAT+ models. In the recently released SWAT+ rev.61.0.1, they included an option to use gwflow module in QSWAT+ for the model setup. I have  attempted to calibrate the gwf and gwf_riv parameters using RSWAT. The model runs successfully, but the NSE value remains unchanged. However, when I try with the CN and surlag.bsn parameters, the NSE varies at different parameters values. 
I would like to request you if it is possible to calibrate SWAT+gw flow model using RSWAT. If so, are there any specific settings  for this version or  can I use it as for the SWAT+? 
Thank you very much in advance!

Kind regards,
Tesfaye

messages.author: e28329d3e25e358e
messages.subject: Re: SWAT+gwflow module
parts:
Hi, 

you need to add gwf and gwf_riv  to the swat parameter file (swatParam.txt) if you work with SWAT model . Please see this video related to this
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=23OPljcB8x8&t=18s

or to the "cal_parms.cal" file if you work with SWAT+ model. In this case, I think also changes in the SWAT+ source code are needed as the "cal_parms.cal" file is changed.
